commit.message:
💿CI/CD(benchmark): compare SDK PR candidates in isolated central runs (#3)

SDK pull requests need a reproducible base/head comparison before
merging. This adds a central candidate workflow that authenticates the
SDK event and current PR head, freezes both revisions and a shared
dependency, and compares them on one host in separate unprivileged
Docker containers.

- Keep the privileged resolver separate from SDK execution; the
execution job receives no repository permissions or dispatch secret.
- Use one image, private work/result volumes, a read-only root, resource
limits, and disconnected networking during measurement. Alternate
base/head and implementation order across rounds.
- Retain candidate-only comparison reports, source/dependency
provenance, raw samples, and diagnostics. Candidate bundles cannot
update official history, latest pointers, or website baselines.
- Handle verified public forks, stale heads, manual recovery, and
duplicate requests for the same head. Comparisons are informational and
have no numeric merge threshold.

## Validation

- `python3 -m unittest discover -s tests` — 52 tests passed.
- `actionlint .github/workflows/candidate.yml
.github/workflows/benchmark.yml` — passed.
- `python3 -m compileall -q scripts tests`, relative documentation
links, and `git diff --check` — passed.
- Both SDK notifier scripts passed 22 mocked scenarios, including
normal/manual/fork routing, stale heads, invalid runs, missing
credentials, and dispatch failures.
- Local ARM Docker smoke and full comparison/export passed with
identical committed SDK revisions as base/head: Go
`3322812352fd473e235f8fba47f056de89bb8139` and Rust
`d821237dc787bdd887e1435e280b95e264328745`. Each leg retained 340
measured and 34 discarded warmup samples; all 34 comparison entries,
bundle/raw hashes, and official-latest ineligibility were verified. This
fixture validates execution, not real PR-event authentication or an
official baseline.
- The first full attempt failed in the existing Go
`TestClientAndCounterLifecycle` initial-state assertion (expected 0,
actual 3). Diagnostics were preserved; the same frozen inputs passed on
retry without bypassing tests or changing dependencies. The cause
remains unconfirmed.

## Delivery and remaining acceptance

Merge this central receiver before the SDK notifier PRs. Actual
opened/reopened/synchronize events, updated heads, and
same-repository/fork PR routing remain to be verified after delivery.
Fork workflow approval follows repository policy. This PR does not
publish candidate data or change the existing official main request
ledger.
